name: zeffect_anim_has_activation_record
description: zEffect_Anim::HasActivationRecord checks whether an activation record with the same node token and animation name is already queued.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zEffect activation-record source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x460400 validates iterating g_zEffectAnim_ActivationRecordTable for g_zEffectAnim_ActivationRecordCount entries, comparing nodeToken, using strncmp over the 32-byte animation name, returning 1 on a match, and returning 0 for no entries or no match.
The native activation-record queue smoke verifies an existing queued record is found by matching node token and animation name, and that a different node token is rejected.
